description:
We are looking for a new colleague for the role of Linux System Engineer, who will join our team and will be responsible for the IT Support processes at our clients' headquarters, in Bucharest.

Job Activities

There are various technical tasks that will need to be performed in this role:

• Troubleshoot various Linux systems issues.

• Install, configure and maintain Linux servers and systems.

• Perform system monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

• Install, configure and maintain system software, both commercial packages and various freely available software (including Apache, MySQL, PHP, etc).

• Manage user access, permissions, and system security best practices.

• Apply security patches and updates to maintain system integrity.

• Provide consulting in both the selection and purchase of hardware and software.

• Ensure the secure and effective operation of computing systems through compliance with procedures and IT Internal Operating Procedures.

• Work with other system engineers and vendors to resolve both hardware and software issues.

• Utilize Internet resources (mailing lists, blogs, etc.) to resolve problems with open-source software.

• Develop and document procedures for startup, execution, shutdown, backup and recovery.

• Monitor systems performance.

Basic Requirements

• Associate’s Degree in Computer Science (or related field) or combined work experience.

• Excellent interpersonal skills suitable for user support and the ability to work well with peer system administrators is required.

• Experience with creating scripts using BASH or other scripting languages is required.

• Demonstrated capabilities to work in a dynamic environment.

Qualifications

•Strong knowledge of multiple operating systems is preferred.

• Good documentation skills, including the ability to prepare simple documentation web pages are also desired.

• Linux certification (RHCSA, RHCE, LPIC, etc.) is considered a plus.

• Experience with cloud platforms and virtual environements.

• Support data storage systems and backup services.

Requirements:

• Understanding of Linux platform components: file systems, processes, memory, etc.

• Ability to operate distributed applications on Linux/Unix platforms.

• Strong knowledge of Linux distributions (Ubuntu, Red Hat, CentOS, Debian, etc.).

• Knowledge of networking, firewalls, and security principles.

• Familiarity with Bash scripting.

• Working knowledge of SQL database operation and programming.

• Experience troubleshooting and addressing incidents from local and distributed applications.

• Pro-actively monitor network and system performance, respond to, and manage, network-reported and customer-reported incidents.

• Take ownership to ensure resolutions are delivered in a timely and efficient manner.

• Perform general “system administration” tasks on all elements of the network including

business applications, databases and web servers.

• Through a proactive and systematic review, discover opportunities for improvement in areas

which could impact system performance or customer satisfaction.

Benefits:

Annual certification budget;

Ongoing training and professional development;

Performance bonuses and project bonuses;

Gym subscription via Wellhub;

An extra day off for 3 years of seniority in the company;

Christmas bonus.


We offer a great opportunity to develop a career in IT, in a young team and an excellent learning environment. We are looking forward to meeting you!
